dct_description_sm: This is a dataset for experiments that look at the change in arrival time of P- and S-waves (the probes) caused by the passage of a lower frequency, higher-amplitude wave (the PUMP).  The experiments were done on 2 samples of Crab Orchard Sandstone at a number of applied loads.  The load was applied using a hydraulic press.
dct_spatial_sm: St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
dct_title_s: Nonlinear Wave Mixing as a Function of Applied Load
